description: Emit an UNENCRYPTED copy of an encrypted PDF (RC4 V1–V4, AES-128, AES-256) given `password` (user or owner; empty user password needs none). CAVEAT: the page tree is rebuilt — signatures and AcroForm are DROPPED. To merely READ an encrypted PDF pass `password` to inspect_pdf / extract_text / extract_attachments / read_form_fields instead. Never cached.

outputMode.description: 'base64' (default) returns the PDF inline; 'file' writes it inside the PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (SECURITY_VIOLATION when the sandbox is not configured).

outputPath.description: Required when outputMode='file'. Relative path inside the sandbox; must end with .pdf.

password.description: Password to open the encrypted source (user or owner). Omit only for documents with an empty user password.

pdfBase64.description: Base64-encoded encrypted PDF to decrypt. NOTE: signatures and AcroForm are dropped (page-tree rebuild).

name: decrypt_pdf

outputSchema.description: Result of a PDF-producing tool. base64 mode: the PDF arrives as an embedded `resource` content block (not duplicated here); file mode: `filePath`.

title: Decrypt a PDF
